title: Local feedback evaluation MVP
description: Milestone epic to prove local feedback-backed evaluation end to end: seed 200 fixture items and linked feedback labels, run local feedback evaluation, persist evaluation/score-result outputs, and verify dashboard plus CLI readback with no hosted GraphQL dependency.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation started: building deterministic 200-item/200-feedback fixture seed, then adding strict local feedback-evaluation smoke and proof-harness integration.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Feedback-evaluation MVP milestone reached for local control plane proof: clean harness now passes end-to-end with 200 seeded feedback fixtures and 200-item evaluate feedback execution in local mode. Non-blocking note: feedback RCA emits expected warnings in demo mode when OpenAI/sentence-transformer dependencies are absent; this does not block evaluation persistence/readback proof.
